alignments.note: Verbless clause with a prepositional predicate: the improper preposition carries the supplied copula and is headed on its single English word (rules 53, 71).
The adverb is rendered by 'that time'; headed on the word carrying the temporal sense, though heading on the deictic 'that' remains defensible (rules 17, 66).
The article takes a bare 'the'. βασιλεία is nominative and has no case for 'of' to realize; the 'of' is licensed by the supplied 'gospel' and stays inside that frame (rule 21).
Bare noun, the determiner standing on its own article (rule 21).
No determiner written for the divine name, so the article anchors nothing (rules 21, 23).
Case preposition stays with the noun where no determiner anchors the article (rule 21).

'the gospel of … is preached' is the ASV's whole rendering of the compound verb, discontinuously (rule 15). The supplied 'the gospel' completes the lexeme's own English and no other token licenses it (rule 103), and that supplied noun is what licenses the following 'of', which therefore belongs to the frame rather than to the nominative βασιλεία (rules 21, 27). The ASV's own margin 'Or, good tidings' on this word corroborates that it renders the εὐαγγελ- element. Head on the verbal core (rule 66).
Anarthrous quantifier expanded with a generic noun, headed on the quantifier (rule 17).
'violently' renders the verb's own force and rides inside its unit.

review_notes: Corrected: 'of' at t014 was on the article ἡ as a case preposition, but βασιλεία is nominative and has no case for it to realize. Rule 21's frame clause puts a preposition licensed by a frame's supplied noun inside the verb's unit (as `οὐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν` → *taketh not account of evil*), so 'of' joins 'the gospel … is preached' and the article keeps a bare 'the'.

The supplied 'the gospel' is folded onto εὐαγγελίζεται under rule 103's licensing test rather than marked added; no source token has spent that English, and the ASV's margin 'Or, good tidings' shows it renders the lexeme.
